fees.notes: UIS last published per-programme international fees on study.uis.edu.my in July 2024 (all-inclusive totals covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D) and graduation; e.g. Foundation in Islamic Studies RM9,817, Bachelor of Accounting RM57,994).
